title: 第13章 天少章笑天第14章 不识好人心
content_zh:
“爸，你认识航阳市这边道上的人吗？”
电话一接通，贺娅娇便直接进入主题。
“娇娇，你怎么了？道上？哪条道？”
电话那头，贺磊一脸疑惑，不知道贺娅娇这是上演的哪一出。
“哎呀，就是混黑道的。”
“黑道？”贺磊吓了一跳，声音忽然变得凝重，问道，“娇娇，你是不是闯了什么祸了？你告诉我，到底发生了什么，不要怕，爸爸马上过来。你在哪里？”
“哎呀，爸，不是我。是……”贺娅娇犹豫了一下，才继续道，“是张逸风，他不小心得罪了道上混的。”
“是张逸风，我还以为是你，吓死爸爸了，不是你最好，航阳市可不是三熊市，爸爸在航阳市并不认识什么人，这次给你办转学，都费了我九牛二虎之力。”
“那怎么办？”贺娅娇有些着急。
“这样吧，我托朋友打电话问问，如果有消息，我打电话给你。”
“恩恩，爸，你赶紧，我等你电话。”
贺娅娇挂了电话，但脸色依旧很凝重。现在她才知道实力和势力的重要，她父亲是有点能耐，但那只是在三熊市，三熊市是在西都省，航阳市在临海省，可谓是一西一东，横跨整个崋夏国，很多事情，贺磊也是心有余而力不足。
就在贺娅娇心思复杂的时候，一道明亮地声音从身旁传来：“你就是新来的同学吧？怎么，你认识张逸风吗，居然替他打电话找关系。”
贺娅娇转过身，这才发现不知道什么时候她身旁站了一位青年，青年一头长发，身材高大，面容俊朗，就这颜值，绝对是校草级别的人物。
青年不仅长得帅气，出身肯定也不平凡，因为他身上的衣服，都是奢侈品牌。
这样帅气又多金的男人，绝对是女人心中的白马王子。
不过，贺娅娇不是一般的女子，帅哥她见得不少，看见青年只是微微惊讶了一下，随后便淡淡问道：“你是谁？”
青年嘴角挂着笑容，歉意地道：“抱歉，忘了自我介绍，我叫章笑天，人称天少，当然，你叫我笑天或者天哥就可以了。”
“哦，你有事吗？”

贺娅娇现在没心情同章笑天聊天搞笑，神色显得有些冷漠。
章笑天没有恼怒，依旧很有风度地道：“你是在为张逸风的事情而烦恼吗？如果是这样，我可以替你解忧。”
“啊？这话什么意思？”
贺娅娇微微一愣，这才抬起头仔细看了章笑天一眼，章笑天属于高高大大，阳光俊秀的那一类人。他比贺娅娇足足高了一个头，身高估计一米九几。
“我的意思是，张逸风的事情我可以替他摆平，但我不是帮他，而是帮你。你，是我喜欢的类型。记住我的名字，我叫章笑天。”
章笑天声音还在飘荡，人已经转身潇洒地朝着张逸风走了过去。
content_en:
"Dad, do you know the people on the road here in Hangyang City?"
As soon as the call was connected, He Yajiao went directly to the topic.
"Jiaojiao, what's wrong with you? On the road? Which road?"
On the other end of the phone, He Lei looked confused, wondering what kind of scene He Yajiao was performing.
"Oh, he's just a gangster."
"Underworld?" He Lei was startled, his voice suddenly became solemn, and he asked, "Jiaojiao, did you get into some trouble? Tell me what happened. Don't be afraid. Dad will be here soon. Where are you?"
"Oh, dad, it's not me. It's..." He Yajiao hesitated for a moment before continuing, "It's Zhang Yifeng. He accidentally offended the gangster on the road."
"It's Zhang Yifeng. I thought it was you. I scared dad to death. You're not the best. Hangyang City is not a three-bear city. Dad doesn't know anyone in Hangyang City. It took me a lot of effort to transfer you to another school this time."
"What should we do?" He Yajiao was a little anxious.
"Let's do this. I'll ask my friend to call and ask. If there's any news, I'll call you."
"Yeah, Dad, hurry up, I'll wait for your call."
He Yajiao hung up the phone, but her face was still solemn. Only now did she realize the importance of strength and power. Her father was somewhat capable, but that was only in Sanxiong City. Sanxiong City was in Xidu Province, and Hangyang City was in Linhai Province. It could be said that it was one west and one east, spanning the entire Weixia Kingdom. He Lei was unable to do many things well.
Just when He Yajiao was having complicated thoughts, a bright voice came from beside her: "You are the new classmate, right? Why, do you know Zhang Yifeng? You actually called him to find a relationship."
He Yajiao turned around and realized that there was a young man standing next to her at some point. The young man had long hair, a tall figure, and a handsome face. With his appearance, he was definitely a school hero.
The young man is not only handsome, but his background must be extraordinary, because the clothes he wears are all luxury brands.
Such a handsome and rich man is definitely the prince charming in a woman's heart.
However, He Yajiao is not an ordinary woman. She has seen a lot of handsome men. She was only slightly surprised when she saw the young man, and then asked lightly: "Who are you?"
The young man had a smile on his face and said apologetically: "Sorry, I forgot to introduce myself. My name is Zhang Xiaotian, known as Tian Shao. Of course, you can just call me Xiaotian or Brother Tian."
"Oh, are you okay?"

He Yajiao was not in the mood to chat and joke with Zhang Xiaotian now, and her expression looked a little cold.
Zhang Xiaotian was not angry, and still said in a very polite manner: "Are you worried about Zhang Yifeng? If so, I can relieve your worries."
"Ah? What do you mean?"
He Yajiao was stunned for a moment, and then she raised her head and took a closer look at Zhang Xiaotian. Zhang Xiaotian was a tall, handsome person. He is a full head taller than He Yajiao, and his height is estimated to be more than 1.9 meters.
"I mean, I can settle Zhang Yifeng's matter for him, but I'm not helping him, but helping you. You are my type. Remember my name, my name is Zhang Xiaotian."
Zhang Xiaotian's voice was still lingering, and he had turned around and walked towards Zhang Yifeng coolly.
